name: Tina Starling
original_name: ティナ・スターリング
source:
The senior student who serves as the student council president. A half-Japanese student with a competitive personality. ...In truth, she's also someone the protagonist admires.

Her distinctive appearance sets her apart from other students, making her a constant focus of attention, especially among the female students.

Yet, perhaps due to her personality and her prominent presence within the school, she seems to lack any close friends she can truly connect with.

Does she occasionally show a lonely expression? She always acts rebellious toward the protagonist, displaying a somewhat condescending attitude, but what are her true feelings...?

[From [url=http://www.ole-m.net/products/ironmaiden/chara.html]official site[/url]]
